reference_uncapped.label: Robot de référence - démo, taille fixe, sans système de dette

baseline.note: each account path uses its own package values above

primary_directional_main_adds.trigger: own-side reference Compte (compte-ctl-2 buy curve for a buy, sell curve for a sell) trend == -1 and choch != 1, from resolved closes strictly before entry; invalid state => multiplier 1.0 and tag state_invalid

exposure_control.type: periodic, every k-th eligible opportunity of the BASELINE stream at 0.5x, all k phases
exposure_control.k_selection: mean (main + rule-permitted add) risk closest to the primary's on the development interval (reported in v2c)
exposure_control.opportunity_id: entry bar time of the baseline stream; an arm opportunity absent from it gets 1.0 and is counted

block_shift_control.indexing: cyclic over the baseline opportunity stream

costs.spread: as quoted per feed (development: harness spread 7)
costs.commission: UNKNOWN - no net label until a verified cost model is registered; observations collected before registration stay gross-only
costs.curve_basis: B (reference rebuilt under the same cost model) for evaluation; A as sensitivity

bootstrap.horizon: exact N_DAYS sampled days, last block trimmed, zero-close days retained, degenerate resamples counted apart
bootstrap.label: conditional development diagnostic

statistics.drawdown_primary: close-to-close realised over ordered closes (exit time)
statistics.drawdown_secondary: daily-sampled realised; MTM main-only proxy (whole-account MTM UNAVAILABLE)

labels.B_secondary: CI90 entirely < 1.0 and point <= 0.80 (reported apart; never a PASS alone)
labels.net_non_degradation: <= 0.05 baseline-risk units per eligible opportunity (baseline-risk unit = baseline mean planned main stop risk); requires the net label => unavailable until a cost model is registered

horizon.evaluation: 120 calendar days from the FROZEN line, one evaluation at the end
horizon.adequacy_target: 600 reference opportunities (not a stopping rule); below it => inconclusive

initial_state: each shadow path starts flat, debt 0, jar 0, streak 0, balance = the account's balance at FROZEN (recorded then)
prospective_collection: read-only: bos_reference_ledger.py attaches by terminal path, no order call path (AST-listed read calls only); shadow paths are simulations
